rows.name: english-01-gemini
rows.subject: English A1
rows.lessonDescription: Use a simple greeting when you meet someone.
rows.caption1: Today we learn one clear and useful greeting.
rows.caption2: Listen carefully and repeat the expression.
rows.caption3: Now use it in a complete sentence.

rows.name: english-02-novita-turbo
rows.subject: English A1
rows.lessonDescription: Use a morning greeting with confidence.
rows.caption1: Good morning is used at the start of the day.
rows.caption2: Listen to the rhythm and repeat it.
rows.caption3: Practice it with someone you know.

rows.name: english-03-novita-fish
rows.subject: English A1
rows.lessonDescription: Say your name and ask another person for theirs.
rows.caption2: What is your name? Listen and repeat.
rows.caption3: Use both lines in a short dialogue.
